description:
Foldable Design & High-Quality Tires: Navigate various terrains with 20" x 2.4" knobby tires and a front suspension fork. Its foldable frame makes it easy to carry, store, and space-saving
5 Working Modes: Electric bikes for men and women offer electric mode, pedal-assist mode, cruise mode, manual mode and walk mode
Multi-Scenario Use: Designed to excel in both urban and off-road settings, this electric bicycle is perfect for commuting or mountain riding, making it an ideal choice for those seeking versatility in their daily rides

Quick & Easy Setup, Plus Unmatched Support: 85% pre-assembled electric bike with all tools and detailed instructions for a hassle-free assembly. Any question please feel free to contact our dedicated support team
